eva (PM): Noticed a bunch of customer tickets: saved queries that include model pins are causing routing surprises and quota blowups when org defaults cascade. Need an API + console contract asap.

kai (eng): Quick summary of problem: saved query restoration can implicitly change the effective model, which then routes to Dedicated pools with different quotas. Console currently restores filters but silently switches model.

mohit (platform): Backend can return explicit fields: `effective_model_id`, `requested_model_id`, `preview_cost_delta_tokens`, and `routing_hint` (e.g. 'dedicated-pool-a' or 'hosted'). That will make console decisions deterministic.

lee (design): UX requirements: show a clear preflight banner when a restore will change model or routing: "This saved view will switch to model X and route to Dedicated. Estimated +3.4k tokens per 1k requests." Provide a toggle "Apply without switching model" that keeps filters only.

ara (sre): Telemetry: new events `saved_query.restore.v1` should include {query_id, user_id, requested_model_id, effective_model_id, preview_cost_delta_tokens, flag}. Sample at 100% for rollout window. Alert if median delta > 20% or if route error-rate increases >1.5x.

kai (eng): API plan: add fields read-only first, header `X-SQ-Schema: v3-preview`. Console will read and show banner but not change behavior behind `sq_model_restore_v3` flag.

eva (PM): Good. Also need policy for quotas: if effective route would exceed committed Dedicated quota, block switch and show guidance: "This model is reserved for Dedicated customers; request quota increase or choose fallback."

mohit (platform): We'll add `quota_blocked` boolean and `quota_owner_contact` string to the response when applicable. Also include `fallback_model_ids` list (comma-separated string) for the console to show alternatives.

lee (design): For the banner copy: "This view will switch you to {model} and may incur higher cost or require Dedicated capacity. Preview: +{X}% token usage. [Switch anyway] [Keep filters only]". Also show small "Why?" link explaining routing.

kai (eng): Client tests: add mapping tests for old->new schema, unit for banner toggle, and E2E that simulates capacity fallback. Feature flag rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with shadow telemetry at each step.

ara (sre): I'll add Grafana panels: median preview delta by org, restore error-rate, and number of blocked-by-quota restores. Will create Pager rule `sq_restore_quota_blocker` when blocked restores > 5 in 5m.

eva (PM): Action items: mohIT PR with shim today, lee mock banner + copy by EOD, kai tests + flag, ara dashboards and alerts. Quick check-in after deploy preview.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview started for platform/sq-model-restore at 2026-03-23T16:21:00Z :rocket:

kai (eng): Aiming to land client PR that reads preview fields and shows the banner in read-only mode this afternoon.

eva (PM): Thanks everyone. We'll validate with a small customer cohort before wider rollout.
